Emma (Head of Product): quick recap from the all-hands Q&A: asked to surface concrete customer win/loss signals and top asks. i'll keep it short.
Raj (Sales): wins = reliability & simple pilot. losses = no VPC option, latency variability, and surprise accuracy changes post-update.
Sophia (CS): example: MediCore left because we couldn't promise a VPC onboarding timeline and their security team wouldn't sign without it.
Ben (Customer Success): recurring asks: 1) 1-week VPC quickstart, 2) explicit SLA tiers & pricing, 3) a reproducible eval kit for regressions.
Lin (Eng PM): proposed minimal VPC beta scope: terraform module, onboarding checklist, KMS examples, runbook. est: 4 sprint-weeks.
David (CEO): leadership wants a one-page commitment (scope, owner, risk) by next Tue. Emma to coordinate.
allhands-bot: :spiral_calendar: task created: "VPC quickstart one-pager" owner: Lin, due: 7 days.
Emma (Head of Product): will post notes + owners here and convert to tickets. please keep follow-ups brief.
